test_title: PYST 08: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one that follows the same logic.

 BEAN - EBAN - BANE

MAKE - AMKE - MKEA
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/532acbaaefddf99c7fc32214195fa96f5b275f433c95d09254f6b749e0800c66.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, BEAN - EBAN - BANE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70f98d2a168d94d61aaf672a2cddfd08990affd3d4a4bb77de8d18a5c8c9b1a0.png] 

For, MAKE - AMKE - MKEA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e53bfa5930b5393876001c250398a40fdbab674ff3de1733e77b86b5ca27cd94.png] 

Similarly,

MACK - AMCK - MCKA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b159d59fc0040b91c52c520bec1e0aba76396561c0d589e641c837d8f25215a5.png] 

Hence, the correct answer **"Option 1".**
